scope: Claude retained-account manager daemon callers, synthetic process and protocol qualification; no installed-provider or live fleet activation
changes: Owner selection stores desired profile without creating a new Claude fleet-switch journal. Legacy journals retain recovery coverage.
First owned selection checks platform, qualified manager and exact native image outside loginMu; the short transaction checks the cached installation identity. Start revalidates.

The existing two-second completion loop processes enrollment and maintains selected plus at most one warm profile outside application locks. Only a creator starts a retained job; alternating cleanup and candidate priority prevents starvation.

Launch preparation includes the actual worktree CWD at finalization and exact selected runtime binding, with before-fork rollback on refusal. Both usage readers bind the owned home and credential generation.

Typed composer and daemon input require current authentication and runtime. Explicit owner terminal input retains common custody checks while allowing approval and cancellation keys; opaque bytes do not prove human origin or grant continuation authority.
